Green Bottle Fly; photographed on 8th of August 2014 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States in a backyard.
The Green bottle fly is actually a blowfly, a member of the family Calliphoridae, Common throughout the UK. Can be found eating on fruit, dead animals, rubbish areas and faeces.
